title: SSE transport intermittent timeout — root cause and fix
symptom: sse-everything-stub tools/call echo hit 120s harness ceiling (iter17 fleet 15/16); intermittent 50-60s failures with upstream SSE POST timeout

root_causes.issue: GET /sse stream used timeout=connect_timeout (single float) → read timeout ~30s on idle SSE → reader task dies with upstream SSE connect timeout
POST reused session.client while GET stream held connection; some POSTs stalled until method_timeout (60s) when upstream held HTTP connection
root_causes.fix: Dedicated short-lived httpx.AsyncClient per POST; aclose() on 202/204 without draining body; MCP_AGENT_SSE_POST_READ_TIMEOUT default 30s

root_causes.issue: Concurrent SSE RPCs raced reader restart → stale session POST timeouts
root_causes.fix: Per-server asyncio.Lock in send_sse_jsonrpc; retry POST once (restart reader only if sse_task.done())

upstream_note: @modelcontextprotocol/server-everything sse transport can be slow to accept POST (~30s) under load; fix converts hard failures into slower successes

verification.pre_fix: 3/10 success with 60s POST timeouts; iter17 fleet timeout at 120085ms
verification.post_fix: 8/8 sequential echo PASS within 90s client timeout; p50 ~80ms
verification.parity: workspace sse_manager.py SHA256 matches zeroshield-mcp-sandbox container
